summary: Completed comprehensive testing of isPerth bug fix and Menu Management system. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified working - Sales Dashboard loads without 'isPerth is not defined' error, Menu Management shows center-specific pricing (INR for India, AUD for Perth) with 146+ real menu items seeded.

login_flow.details: Login with DB-driven center dropdown works. 10 centers loaded from /api/centers. Super Admin (PB-MGT, 9741399190, 123456) login successful.

isPerth_bug_fix.details: SalesDataEntry.jsx uses isIntl(center, centersList) instead of isPerth. No 'isPerth is not defined' error on Sales Dashboard page.

sales_dashboard.details: Sales Dashboard loads correctly with GST calculation (5% for India), shows Total Sales, Cash Sales, Online Sales, Expenses breakdown.

expense_entry.details: Expense Entry tab loads without errors. fmtCurrency wrapper uses centersList for currency detection.

menu_management_page.details: Menu Management page loads at /menu-management. Shows 'Admin only' access control. Center selector, search, and item grid working.

menu_items_inr_pricing.details: PB-HSR shows INR (₹) pricing. 196 available / 204 total items. Sample: BG Aloocha Paratha ₹189, Misal Pav ₹199.

menu_items_aud_pricing.details: PB-PERTH shows AUD ($) pricing. 177 available / 204 total items. Sample: BG Aloocha Paratha $7.99, Misal Pav $12.99.

menu_items_availability.details: Some items unavailable at Perth (e.g., Balgopal Thali shows 'No' with price 0). 24+ items marked unavailable at Perth.

seed_menu_data_endpoint.details: /api/masters/seed-menu-data returns 146+ items (29 created + 117 updated). Categories: 17 seeded.

menu_categories_endpoint.details: /api/masters/menu_categories/list returns 17+ categories including SNACKS, THALI, SWEET, RICE, ROTI.

sidebar_menu_management.details: Menu Management appears under Management category in sidebar (admin only). UtensilsCrossed icon used.

critical_code_review_comments: SalesDataEntry.jsx correctly passes centersList prop and uses isIntl() helper instead of hardcoded isPerth check
ExpenseEntry.jsx uses fmtCurrency wrapper that correctly handles center-based currency detection
MenuManagement.jsx properly fetches centers from DB and shows center-specific pricing grid
seed_data_creation: 146 menu items seeded via /api/masters/seed-menu-data with India (INR) and Australia (AUD) pricing
